clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wailing Caverns, a glowing shard bears a taint Falla Sagewind cannot ignore. She binds its pure, disturbed essence of the Emerald Dream into the Nightmare Shard and sends it to senior druids for a warning kept from others.

Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Falla Sagewind examines a mysterious glowing shard and finds its energy darker than she expected. It reflects an unnatural affliction in the Emerald Dream, like a waking nightmare. Falla binds this tainted essence into the Nightmare Shard and orders it carried without delay to elder leaders of the Cenarion Circle.
